tool.name: TraderSync
tool.description: TraderSync is a trading journal with broker sync, reports and a market replay tool. Paid plans differ by account limits and by how fine the replay is.
features: Reports, tags and a strategy checker
Market replay, with finer updates on higher plans
Stocks, futures, crypto and forex on the plans described
tool.pricing_note: Prices from the official pricing page on 11 Oct 2026. The page listed more than one set of account limits, so those limits are not repeated here.
